title: Transporter Cost Analytics
description: An interactive frontend dashboard built with React and Recharts to visualize and analyze complex transportation cost data.

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.content: Business analysts were spending hours manually exporting and parsing Excel sheets to calculate transportation efficiencies. They needed a unified dashboard that could visualize this data in real-time.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.content:
We built a modern, responsive web application focused heavily on Data Visualization and User Experience.

### Key Architectural Decisions:
1. **React.js & TypeScript**: Provided a strong foundation for a maintainable and scalable frontend codebase.
2. **Recharts Integration**: Implemented interactive charts (bar, line, and pie) to visualize cost distributions and trends.
3. **Zustand State Management**: Used Zustand to efficiently manage complex filter states across multiple dashboard widgets.
4. **React-Table**: Implemented highly customizable, sortable, and filterable data tables for deep dives into specific cost records.

impact.title: Business Impact
impact.content: The dashboard empowered analysts to identify cost inefficiencies instantly, saving hours of manual labor and leading to better resource allocation.

results.title: Key Results
results.content:
- **Real-time Visualization** of complex financial data
- **Seamless Filtering** using optimized state management
- **Accessible Reporting** via responsive data tables
